map.切花开放分 6 级：花苞（紧实未绽）、初绽（外层花瓣微展）、半开（约 50% 开: Cut flowers are graded into 6 bloom stages: bud (tight, unopened), breaking bud (outer petals slightly spread), half-open (about 50% open), near-full (about 80% open), fully open (fully spread with visible stamens), and over-ripe (petals drooping). Harvest and display are best at breaking-bud to half-open (longest vase life); the near-full stage suits same-day use, and gift flowers should use the breaking-bud stage. Vase life shortens as bloom stage increases; after over-ripe, flowers wilt every 1 to 2 days.

map.等级 0 花苞期：紧闭，适合远距离运输/长期储存，但瓶插开放慢。\n等级 1 显:
Stage 0 Bud: closed, for long-distance transport/long storage but slow to open in vase.
Stage 1 Color-showing: tip slightly loose, for use in 2-3 days (lily/tulip best cut at this stage).
Stage 2 Breaking bud: about 1/3 open, the best cutting stage for most flowers, balancing openness and life.
Stage 3 Half-open: 1/2-2/3 open, common stage for bouquets, use same/next day.
Stage 4 Near-full: fully open, best appearance but life starts shortening (sunflower/chrysanthemum best at this stage).
Stage 5 Full bloom: petals reflexed, for instant display/photos, wilts soon.
Conclusion: need 2-3 days ahead choose stages 1-2, same-day choose 3-4, instant display choose 5; bouquet making prefer stages 2-3.
map.看使用时间：提前 2–3 天用选显色/初开（1–2 级），当天用选半开（3 级）: Depends on usage time: 2-3 days ahead choose color-showing/breaking-bud (stages 1-2), same-day choose half-open (stage 3), immediate photo/display choose near-full (stages 4-5). Bouquets commonly use stages 2-3, open enough yet still good for several more days in the vase.
map.低等级花苞一直不开怎么办？: What if a low-stage bud will not open?
map.可催花：温水（≈40℃）深水醒花、稍提高室温、避直射光，多数花苞 1–2 天开放: You can force opening: wake flowers in deep warm water (≈40°C), raise room temperature slightly, avoid direct light; most buds open in 1-2 days. Some varieties (e.g. carnation) open slowly by nature. For high-stage flowers do the opposite: use soon, keep cool and away from light to extend life.
